# CANDIDA VULVOVAGINITIS

Candida vulvovaginitis typically presents with valvular irritation, burning or pruritus. Vaginal pH should be measured, and the specimen should be examined under the microscope for clue cells (epithelial cell coated with bacteria) to exclude bacterial vaginosis. In candida vulvovaginitis, the vaginal pH is typically normal (4-4.5) and vaginal discharge is typically thick and curdy with white plaques on vaginal mucosa. Diagnosis is confirmed by identifying fungus or yeast with KOH prep.
Most non-C. albicans species respond to fluconazole treatment except C. krusei and C. glabrata. C. krusei can be treated with topical agents as for complicated candida vulvovaginitis below. C. glabrata treatment is complicated and azole therapy is frequently unsuccessful. Consult Infectious Diseases in patients with C. glabrata vulvovaginitis.
Recurrent candida vulvovaginitis is treated as complicated candida vulvovaginitis for induction treatment, followed by maintenance regimen for 6 months.

## Candida vulvovaginitis in pregnancy:

## Inpatient

Clotrimazole vaginal cream 1% 1 applicatorful qhs for 7 daysTreatment of uncomplicated candida vulvovaginitis Fluconazole 150 mg PO once ($) [R,DI]
< OR >
Clotrimazole vaginal 1% cream 1 applicator full qhs ($) [M] for 7 to 14 days
< OR >
Terconazole 0.4% vaginal cream 1 applicator full qhs ($) [M] for 7 days

### Treatment of complicated candida vulvovaginitis (e.g. immunocompromised, severe disease) or recurrent infection induction treatment

Fluconazole 150 mg PO q72h for 7 days (3 doses) ($) [R,DI]
< OR >
Clotrimazole vaginal 1% cream 1 applicator full qhs ($) [M] for 10-14 days
< OR >
Terconazole 0.4% vaginal cream 1 applicator full qhs ($) [M] for 10-14 days

### Recurrent candida vulvovaginitis maintenance regimen following induction treatment above

Fluconazole 150 mg PO every 7 days ($) [R,DI] for 6 months

### Treatment of C. glabrata vulvovaginitis

Failure of azole therapy is common, alternative topical treatments below require compounding by a pharmacist. Please call pharmacy to order.
Topical boric acid capsule 600 mg intravaginal qhs for 14 days
